summary: Inside the hovercraft, there is no morning, only darkness, which is then broken when 'the fluorescent light sticks flicker on,' ending the darkness and beginning what will be Neo's training day.

what_changes.before: In darkness with no sense of morning, having just been told to rest before training.
what_changes.after: The fluorescent light sticks flicker on, signaling the start of the day and his training.
what_changes.evidence: there is only darkness and then the fluorescent light sticks flicker on.

event_hint.one_line: The hovercraft's fluorescent lights flicker on, marking the start of Neo's training day.
